---
name: Engineering or documentation proposal
about: Propose a bounded change with evidence and clear status
---

## Problem and scope

Describe the current behavior and the intended outcome. Identify the component without including deployed device identifiers.

## Evidence

Provide public-safe source/build/test references. Distinguish observations from assumptions and proposed acceptance.

## Boundaries and rights

Explain effects on control/safety, persistence, connectivity, licensing or publication. Identify third-party content if relevant.

## Remaining decisions

List missing evidence or decisions. Do not post credentials, private designs or vulnerabilities here; use the private contact in SECURITY.md.
